# Stefan's Spinners — full documentation

Package: stefans-spinners
Version: 1.0.1
Author: Stefan Mihajlovic
License: MIT
Website: https://spinners.stefanmihajlovic.com
Source: https://github.com/Stefan-Mihajlovic/stefans-spinners

## Install

npm install stefans-spinners
pnpm add stefans-spinners
yarn add stefans-spinners
bun add stefans-spinners

Requires React >=18 for React components. The CSS can be used independently of React.
ES modules, CommonJS, and TypeScript declarations are included.

## React usage

Import the component. The package automatically installs its bundled stylesheet once per browser document; no separate CSS import is needed for browser usage.

```tsx
import { Orbit } from 'stefans-spinners';

export default function Loading() {
  return <Orbit size={32} color="#b5a0ff" speed={1.2} label="Loading content" />;
}
```

There is no default export. Every spinner is a named export. Components are stateless, do not use hooks, and support server rendering without accessing browser globals. Automatic styles are installed when the package loads in the browser. For styled server HTML before JavaScript loads, React Server Components with no browser import, or a Content Security Policy that blocks inline stylesheets, import "stefans-spinners/styles.css" once in the app root (for example app/layout.tsx in Next.js). The CSS export remains available for existing integrations.

## Available named exports

Circular: Orbit, Arc, Ring, Ripple, Breathe, Comet, Dual, Radar, Satellite, Eclipse, Vortex, Gyro, Clock, Compass, Gauge, Slinky.
Dots: Dots, Pulse, Chase, Bounce, Pendulum, Helix, Binary, Beads, Infinity, Newton, Shuttle, Typing, Fountain, Rain.
Bars: Wave, Bars, Stack, Zigzag, Domino, Meteor.
Geometric: Grid, Flare, Flip, Bloom, Square, Hourglass, Spark, Star, Twinkle, Pinwheel, Asterisk, Constellation, Steps, Tetris, Checker, Diamond, Prism, Fan, Flower, Crosshair, Pacman, Conveyor, Firework, Book.

## Shared props

- size: number. Diameter in pixels. Default 32. Nonpositive or nonfinite values fall back to 32.
- color: string. Any CSS color. Default currentColor (inherits text color).
- speed: number. Seconds per animation cycle. Default 1.2. Smaller values are faster. Nonpositive or nonfinite values fall back to 1.2.
- easing: SpinnerEasing. One of linear, ease, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out. Omit to keep the spinner’s original timing. Applies to all animated parts. Set via --ss-easing in plain CSS.
- label: string. Accessible label. Default Loading.
- decorative: boolean. Default false. Set true when surrounding text already identifies the loading state. Removes the status role and label, and sets aria-hidden=true.
- paused: boolean. Default false. Pauses the CSS animation.
- className: string. Extra classes appended to the spinner classes.
- style: React.CSSProperties. Inline styles; user styles take precedence.
- Other standard span HTML attributes are forwarded, except children and color. Accessibility role, aria-label, and aria-hidden are controlled by label/decorative.

## Shape controls

Each spinner exposes controls for its own geometry. The gallery updates the React example as you adjust them.

```tsx
<Arc size={48} strokeWidth={5} borderRadius={2.5} arcLength={220} />
<Ring size={48} strokeWidth={5} trackOpacity={0.2} />
<Bars size={48} barWidth={8} borderRadius={4} />
<Bloom size={48} petalWidth={14} petalLength={20} />
<Dual size={48} outerStrokeWidth={5} innerStrokeWidth={2} />
<Hourglass size={48} borderRadius={4} />
```

| Spinner | Props |
| --- | --- |
| Orbit | `strokeWidth`, `tilt` |
| Arc | `strokeWidth`, `borderRadius`, `arcLength` |
| Ring | `strokeWidth`, `borderRadius`, `arcLength`, `trackStrokeWidth`, `trackOpacity` |
| Dots | `dotSize`, `borderRadius`, `gap` |
| Wave | `barWidth`, `borderRadius`, `pulseScale` |
| Pulse | `borderRadius`, `pulseScale` |
| Ripple | `strokeWidth`, `pulseScale` |
| Bars | `barWidth`, `borderRadius`, `pulseScale` |
| Grid | `gap`, `borderRadius` |
| Breathe | `firstStrokeWidth`, `secondStrokeWidth` |
| Comet | `strokeWidth`, `borderRadius`, `arcLength` |
| Dual | `outerStrokeWidth`, `innerStrokeWidth`, `outerBorderRadius`, `innerBorderRadius`, `outerArcLength`, `innerArcLength` |
| Flare | `barWidth`, `borderRadius` |
| Flip | `borderRadius` |
| Bloom | `petalWidth`, `petalLength` |
| Chase | `dotSize`, `borderRadius` |
| Bounce | `dotSize`, `borderRadius`, `gap`, `bounceHeight` |
| Pendulum | `dotSize`, `gap`, `swing` |
| Square | `outerStrokeWidth`, `innerStrokeWidth`, `borderRadius` |
| Stack | `borderRadius`, `gap` |
| Zigzag | `barWidth`, `borderRadius` |
| Hourglass | `waistWidth`, `borderRadius` |
| Radar | `outerStrokeWidth`, `sweepWidth`, `sweepAngle` |
| Spark | `dotSize`, `borderRadius` |
| Star | `innerRadius` |
| Twinkle | `innerRadius`, `pulseScale` |
| Satellite | `outerStrokeWidth`, `dotSize` |
| Eclipse | `strokeWidth` |
| Helix | `dotSize`, `travelDistance` |
| Pinwheel | `petalWidth`, `petalLength` |
| Asterisk | `barWidth`, `petalLength`, `borderRadius` |
| Binary | `dotSize`, `gap` |
| Beads | `dotSize`, `pulseScale` |
| Constellation | `dotSize`, `pulseScale` |
| Vortex | `firstStrokeWidth`, `secondStrokeWidth`, `thirdStrokeWidth`, `borderRadius`, `arcLength` |
| Gyro | `outerStrokeWidth`, `innerStrokeWidth`, `tilt` |
| Infinity | `dotSize`, `travelDistance` |
| Newton | `dotSize`, `swing` |
| Shuttle | `dotSize`, `strokeWidth`, `travelDistance` |
| Typing | `dotSize`, `gap`, `pulseScale` |
| Domino | `barWidth`, `borderRadius`, `tilt` |
| Steps | `dotSize`, `borderRadius` |
| Tetris | `dotSize`, `borderRadius` |
| Checker | `gap`, `borderRadius` |
| Diamond | `strokeWidth`, `borderRadius`, `pulseScale` |
| Prism | `petalWidth`, `tilt` |
| Fan | `petalWidth`, `petalLength`, `borderRadius` |
| Flower | `petalWidth`, `petalLength`, `borderRadius` |
| Clock | `outerStrokeWidth`, `innerStrokeWidth`, `trackStrokeWidth`, `petalLength`, `travelDistance`, `borderRadius` |
| Crosshair | `strokeWidth`, `petalLength`, `borderRadius` |
| Rain | `dotSize`, `strokeWidth` |
| Compass | `strokeWidth`, `petalWidth`, `swing` |
| Meteor | `strokeWidth`, `petalLength`, `borderRadius` |
| Pacman | `dotSize`, `sweepAngle` |
| Conveyor | `dotSize`, `borderRadius` |
| Fountain | `dotSize`, `bounceHeight` |
| Gauge | `strokeWidth`, `petalLength`, `swing` |
| Slinky | `strokeWidth`, `gap` |
| Firework | `barWidth`, `petalLength`, `borderRadius` |
| Book | `strokeWidth`, `borderRadius` |

Clock has twelve fixed hour marks and two hands sharing a central pivot. `speed` controls one minute-hand revolution; the hour hand takes twelve times as long.

All geometry props are numbers. Dimensions are in pixels; `tilt`, `swing`, `sweepAngle`, `arcLength`, `outerArcLength`, and `innerArcLength` use degrees. `trackOpacity`, `pulseScale`, and `innerRadius` use fractions from 0 to 1. For Star and Twinkle, `innerRadius` is the inner-to-outer radius ratio. Helix `travelDistance` is the horizontal displacement from its center in pixels; Pinwheel uses `petalWidth` and `petalLength` for its blades. Omitted geometry values use the spinner’s defaults; most scale with `size`. Explicit pixel values keep their size and are clamped to the supported range. Nonfinite values use the default. Unsupported geometry props are ignored. `customizationControls` exports the supported props, units, defaults, and ranges for each spinner; `relative: true` means the metadata’s default/min/max are multiplied by `size`.

Hourglass defaults to a 6 px waist and 8 px corner radius at size 48 (both scale proportionally with `size`); set it to `0` for sharp corners. Its rounded SVG mask is generated when props change, while rotation remains a CSS animation. Dual and Square have separate outer/inner widths; Breathe has first/second ring widths; Radar has a ring width and a sweep width. The legacy `strokeWidth` prop still sets both stroke widths unless a part-specific value overrides it.

## Accessibility

By default the outer span has role="status" and aria-label="Loading". Animated child spans are aria-hidden. All animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Set aria-busy on the content being loaded. Avoid putting multiple announcing spinners in the same region. If nearby text says Loading, use decorative on the spinner.

```tsx
<button disabled>
  <Dots size={20} decorative /> Saving…
</button>
```

## CSS-only usage

Import 'stefans-spinners/styles.css' with your bundler or copy dist/styles.css to your public assets and link it from HTML. Render a span with ss-spinner and the variant class. Use child spans with --ss-i starting at zero. All IDs are lowercase component names.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles.css">
<span class="ss-spinner ss-dots" role="status" aria-label="Loading"
  style="--ss-size:32px;--ss-color:#b5a0ff;--ss-speed:1.2s">
  <span aria-hidden="true" style="--ss-i:0"></span>
  <span aria-hidden="true" style="--ss-i:1"></span>
  <span aria-hidden="true" style="--ss-i:2"></span>
</span>
```

Child counts:
Orbit 3; Arc 1; Ring 1; Dots 3; Wave 5; Pulse 1; Ripple 3; Bars 4; Grid 9; Breathe 2; Comet 1; Dual 2; Flare 8; Flip 1; Bloom 6; Chase 8; Bounce 3; Pendulum 3; Square 2; Stack 3; Zigzag 5; Hourglass 1; Radar 2; Spark 4; Star 1; Twinkle 1; Satellite 2; Eclipse 1; Helix 8; Pinwheel 6.

Add ss-paused to the outer span to pause. CSS custom properties: --ss-size, --ss-color, --ss-speed, --ss-easing. All class names and keyframes use the ss- prefix. Ring uses color-mix; Comet uses mask and conic-gradient. Target current evergreen browsers.

Shape CSS variables (set on the outer span):
- --ss-inner-radius: Star and Twinkle innerRadius, unitless fraction.
- --ss-travel-distance: Helix travelDistance, px.
- --ss-stroke-width: strokeWidth, px.
- --ss-outer-stroke-width and --ss-inner-stroke-width: outerStrokeWidth and innerStrokeWidth, px.
- --ss-first-stroke-width and --ss-second-stroke-width: Breathe ring widths, px.
- --ss-sweep-width: Radar sweepWidth, px.
- --ss-tilt: tilt, deg.
- --ss-track-opacity: trackOpacity, unitless.
- --ss-dot-size: dotSize, px.
- --ss-radius: borderRadius, px.
- --ss-bar-width: barWidth, px.
- --ss-pulse-scale: pulseScale, unitless.
- --ss-gap: gap, px.
- --ss-petal-width: petalWidth, px.
- --ss-petal-length: petalLength, px.
- --ss-bounce-height: bounceHeight, px.
- --ss-swing: swing, deg.
- --ss-hourglass-mask: custom CSS mask-image value. For CSS-only Hourglass, supply a rounded SVG mask to change its outline; waistWidth and borderRadius are React geometry props that generate this mask, not standalone CSS controls.
- --ss-sweep-angle: sweepAngle, deg.

## Catalog

import { spinners } from 'stefans-spinners/catalog';

The catalog has no React dependency and returns entries with name, id, category, count, and description. SpinnerName and SpinnerVariant TypeScript types are exported from the catalog and main entry.

## Troubleshooting

If a spinner is invisible or static, confirm the browser loaded the component bundle and its automatic stylesheet. For server-only rendering or a CSP blocking inline stylesheets, load stefans-spinners/styles.css explicitly. Check whether reduced motion is enabled or paused is true. color="currentColor" needs a contrasting inherited text color. CSS animations intentionally do not indicate real progress percentages.

### Arc geometry

`arcLength`, `outerArcLength`, and `innerArcLength` are measured in degrees. `borderRadius` rounds the ends of Arc, Ring, and Comet; Dual uses independent `outerBorderRadius` and `innerBorderRadius`. Radius is in pixels and visually stops at half the relevant stroke thickness (fully round). Vortex exposes all three stroke widths separately. Arc geometry uses a static SVG mask; motion still runs entirely in CSS. Set geometry through component props; CSS stroke variables alone do not recompute a mask.

For CSS-only Infinity, `--ss-path` is a CSS `path()` value in pixels, with a default path sized for 32px. Use the React component to automatically rebuild it when changing size or loop width.
